Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-01.htm.text: Magister Hanellin: Have you heard the story of the ancient emperor who achieved immortality? He was imprisoned by the gods in a high tower where he suffered for hundreds of years before going mad and becoming a monster. The secrets of immortality, the vast treasures of the ancient empire, the secre…

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-05.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Listen. I'll tell you the story about an ancient king who gained eternal life but paid the price by being imprisoned in a high tower by the gods? After being trapped for hundreds of years without being able to die, the king went mad and turned into a monster... The key to eternal…

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-06.html.text: Magister Hanellin: You haven't left for the Forsaken Plains yet? Do you remember what I said? Go to the Forsaken Plains and hunt Yintzu or Paliote , and bring back the Monster's Shell as proof. Don't keep me waiting!

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-07.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Have you brought me a powerstone? This should fetch a handsome price from the Dwarves, I'll give it to Blacksmith Wilbert later. Well, now at least you will avoid dying in vain. Your task will not be easy... If you have any comrades you should bring at least two with you...

The arks are hidden in Aden, Giran and somewhere in the Dark Elven Forest beyond the Misty Mountains. Here in Aden, Madam Claudia Athebalt is searching for the ark. In Giran, a fixer named Martien of the Town of Giran is searching …

Claudia Athebaldt has been expecting you for some time now. She will start complaining soon, and I'm sure you don't want me to have to tell her that you are un…

I have already sent some funding to Martien of Giran Castle . If you don't report there immediately he will get angry and call the Contract due! I don't want t…

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-21.html.text: Magister Hanellin: The Book of Saint, the Bough of Saint, and the Blood of Saint! Finally, the three holy items have gathered in one place. You did well, truly. I will use these to find a way for you to stand up to the mad king. In the meantime, I must ask another favor from you. It isn't anything …

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-20.html.text: Magister Hanellin: You still have not found all of the arks. Please hurry! I know you are encountering many difficulties, but I have faith in your abilities.

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-22.html.text: Magister Hanellin: I don't understand... I heard that you had obtained the arks, but where are they? If I didn't know better I would accuse you of hiding them away somewhere... You must have forgotten to bring them with you, am I right? You will go and get them NOW, am I right?

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-40.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Why do you still have all three cloths? Although they are quite expensive, it does you no good to have more than one, and it would be advantageous for you to work with reliable friends!

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-41.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Surely you are now aware of the incantation woven into this cloth? When soaked with the blood of the saint it will activate the Angelic Vortex. Unfortunately, we don't have enough of the blood of the saint to soak the entire cloth... And besides, there are three cloths that need …

But could you do a simple favor for me before you go? Just buy me five Antidotes and one Healing Potion. Please?

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-24.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Have you brought what I asked for? Please give them to me! I shall mix them together...(Gulp Gulp) Ahh~! That feels good. Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-25.html.text: Magister Hanellin: How much do you know about the Platinum tribe? They were ordered by the gods to guard Baium... They will not let anyone in or out of his room... They will even attempt to kill anyone who dares approach the top floor where the throne is located! Although their devotion to their jo…

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-27.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Listen carefully. Soak the White Fabric in the blood of Platinum tribe shamans and overlords and wrap yourself in it. The Angelic Vortex will accept you. This money should cover your travel expenses, with a little something extra for your trouble... I'm sorry that it can't be mor…

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-28.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Good job! You killed all the guardians and recovered the relics! Actually, before I tell you how to disguise yourself so that you can visit the Emperor, I've got a question for you. You seem like an ambitious sort... Rather than going to meet with the old Emperor, would you rathe…

links.text: "No, I want to meet the Emperor."

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-31.html.text: Magister Hanellin: I've done everything I could do for you. Now you must kill shamans and overlords of the platinum race , soak the white cloth in their blood, wrap it around your body and present yourself to the demented emperor... Good luck!

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-32.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Have you forgotten your task? After soaking the cloth with the blood of shamans and overlords of the Platinum tribe , come back here. We have some more business to attend to...

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-42.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Ah, I am truly happy to see that you survived... Now I can continue my story... Do you recognize this? Would you like more of it?

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-43.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Do you remember when I mentioned the bloodless angels? There is something I must tell you... That wasn't exactly true. When angels return to heaven, their physical bodies disappear. During this process a large amount of pure water is produced... This is known as the "blood of an …

links.text: "Tell me more about the blood of an angel."

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-44.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Now we have no use for the blood of the platinum tribe. They no longer wish to meet with Baium. We must obtain the "blood of an angel". Go and kill guardian angels and seal angels , soak these cloths with their blood and bring them back to me.

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-45.html.text: Magister Hanellin: What are you doing? Don't you still have work to do? Go and kill the Guardian Angels and Seal Angels. Then, dip these clothes in their blood and bring them back to me.

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-46.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Ah, yes, 10 pieces. It is good that your conscience doesn't bother you about murdering angels. Others in your position have gone mad! In fact, one died yesterday by jumping into the Blazing Swamp, shouting something about being "punished by the gods"! It is good that you can keep…

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-48.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Where are the other pieces? I distinctly remember asking you to bring me 10 pieces of White Fabric soaked in blood... You haven't thrown them away or given them to someone else, have you? Oh, well, nothing can be done about it now. Since you've done the work, I'll pay you, but I …

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-52.html.text: Magister Hanellin: You still have the items with you, eh? Sir Gustav Athebaldt of Oren, Hardin and Iason Heine of Innadril ... They are not the kind of people you want to get on the wrong side of... They have been promised the items! Please hurry...

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-53.html.text: Magister Hanellin: What did you do with the 10 pieces of Blooded Fabric I gave you? Don't tell me you lost them!? You're a terrible disappointment to me! I've no use for the likes of you! Be gone!

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-54.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Good job! Thank you for your hard work. We haven't heard the last of those three, I guarantee... Ha! They may be a lot of trouble, but the money is good, no? Here is the compensation I promised. What do you want to do now? I still have quite a bit of work to do. Would you like to…

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-49.html.text: Magister Hanellin: You haven't answered my question... What do you want to do? Do you want to continue to do this work or do you want to quit?

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-02.htm.text: Magister Hanellin: Yes. The poor wretch is under the guard of the Platinum Tribe. Even demons gather at the Tower of Insolence expecting to obtain something... This will not be an easy task, but I intend to uncover his secrets for the good of all mankind.

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-03.htm.text: Magister Hanellin: Would you believe for the good of the world? Well, it wouldn't exactly be a lie. Look, I thought you would be intrigued by this story. Whether it is the treasure, the knowledge, whatever... You can find what you want... Do you seek my help?

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-04.htm.text: Magister Hanellin: Very well. But you must first prove your worth. I'm a poor judge of character, so I don't want to see my efforts come to nothing just because you have a kind faith. Hmm... We don't have to go far to settle this. Do you know the Forsaken Plains ? Go there and hunt either Yintzu or…

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-08.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Very well, as you wish... Inside the Tower of Insolence you will find a teleportation device called the Dimensional Vortex . Oh, I see you are familiar with it. All the other devices in the tower have been activated, but this device, located on the top floor of the tower, has fru…

links.text: "What do you want me to do?"

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-10.html.text: Magister Hanellin: There were three relics left behind by Saint Solina. The first one is her staff. The second is her diary. And the third is her own blood... When you collect all three of these items, the ancient emperor will grant an audience with you.

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-11.html.text: Magister Hanellin: The story of the construction of the Tower of Insolence and the defeat of Baium is recorded in the book of the saint. However, the book itself does not impart knowledge. About 20 years ago a book was circulated purporting to be a copy... It was total rubbish. It was a book of hym…

links.text: "Tell me about the blood of the saint."

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-12.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Well, there is no guarantee that this will work... But to open the door, my theory is that any gatekeeper would respond to the owner's blood... Yes, you heard correctly. The woman known as a saint was actually the daughter of Baium! Apparently after losing his mind he murdered hi…

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-26.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Oh, well, I digress... High-ranking members of the Platinum tribe and bloodless angels have been using the Angelic Vortex to visit the Emperor. Perhaps if you disguised yourself to look like them, you could pass through the vortex ! Follow my instructions carefully and you may su…

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-29.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Oh, really? I thought this would be a good opportunity for you... I suppose I'll have to find someone else. If you want to meet the Emperor so badly, I have an idea... You could disguise yourself as a member of the Platinum tribe! If you can trick the Angelic Vortex, you'll be ab…

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-30.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Ah, yes, I've always admired that about you. In order for me to explain our work to you properly, I must first tell you how to access the emperor's room. First, you must disguise yourself as a member of the Platinum tribe. You still have the White Fabric I gave you, right? Soak i…

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-47.html.text: Magister Hanellin: Well, I suppose I will have to tell you now, since you'll have to deliver the items to them anyway... First is Sir Gustav Athebaldt of the Town of Oren . He is a black-hearted scoundrel, a distant relative of Claudia Athebalt. He has been secretly supporting young warlords and ex…

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-50.html.text: Magister Hanellin: All right. Here, as always, are 10 pieces of white fabric. You know what to do next don't you? Go and kill guardian angels and seal angels . We are truly tempting the wrath of the gods...

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30864-51.html.text: Magister Hanellin: You are quite a disappointment to me! I thought we were starting a long relationship... Or...have you found another? Ha! Do what you want. I appreciate your hard work and hope to work with you again some day.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30864-1.ht.text: Magister Hanellin: The king of this country so focused on foreign intrigues that he is blind to the revolt brewing in his own capital! There are dozens of plots, cabals and conspiracies to dethrone him and take over this castle. Those self-righteous Elves may frown and sniff at the goings-on, but w…

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30864-note.text: Magister Henellin: I'm dreadfully sorry but I only teach Dark Elven mages. You should talk to that serious-looking fellow over there. He specializes in Dark Elven warriors. Only Dark Elves are allows in this guild.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30864.html.text: Magister Hanellin: People say this town is the center of culture and religion, but to me it feels like like a piece of rotten wood -- ready to collapse at the slightest push. Humans are closer to Dark Elves than they think...

You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
